modes.name: acceptEdits
modes.description: Automatically accepts file edits and common filesystem commands such as `mkdir`, `touch`, `mv`, and `cp` for paths in the working directory or `additionalDirectories`

modes.name: auto
modes.description: Runs without routine prompts; before actions such as shell commands and network requests run, a background [classifier](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes.md#eliminate-prompts-with-auto-mode) checks that they align with your request

modes.name: bypassPermissions
modes.description: Skips permission prompts, except for the [actions no mode auto-approves](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes.md#actions-no-mode-auto-approves)

modes.name: default
modes.description: Prompts before most edits, shell commands, and network requests. Labeled Manual in the CLI, the VS Code and JetBrains extensions, and the desktop app, and Claude Code accepts `manual` as an alias

modes.name: dontAsk
modes.description: Auto-denies every call that would otherwise prompt, though in [some setups](#precedence-among-rules-hooks-and-mods) a [mod](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/overview.md) you installed can still approve some of those calls. File reads in your working directories and other actions that need no approval still run, as do tools pre-approved via `/permissions` or `permissions.allow` rules. `AskUserQuestion` and [some other calls](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes.md#allow-only-pre-approved-tools-with-dontask-mode) are denied even if you've allowed them

modes.name: plan
modes.description: Claude reads files and runs read-only shell commands to explore but doesn't edit your source files; with [auto mode](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes.md#eliminate-prompts-with-auto-mode) available, classifier-approved commands also run. Labeled Plan in the CLI and the VS Code extension
